Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{10}^{x}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{{10}^{x}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}{|}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}\cdot {10}^{x}\,{|}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}({10}^{2}-{10}^{0}) \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}(100-1) \\  & =\frac{99}{\operatorname{ln}⁡10}.\end{aligned}
$$
